newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Man accused of NZ massacre pleads insanity.
newsitem.headline: Man accused of NZ massacre pleads insanity.

text.p: The man accused of the Raurimu shotgun massacre in New Zealand pleaded not guilty on the grounds of insanity in the High Court at Hamilton on Tuesday.
Six people were shot dead and six others wounded in the central North Island hamlet of Raurimu on February 8 this year.
Stephen Lawrence Anderson, 24, faces six charges of murder and eight of attempted murder.
Lawyer Stuart Grieve told the court his client's pleas of not guilty would be based on a defence of insanity.
Anderson stood quietly in the dock, flanked by two prison officers and a police officer. In a steady voice he emphasised the word "not" as he repeated "not guilty" to each charge.
He was remanded in custody at Tokanui Hospital.
Justice Penlington said Anderson's trial would start on December 1 and run for two weeks.
